name: Mochizuki Honami
source:
Honami is an honor student who is smart, athletic, and really kind. She is an childhood friends with [url=/c123759]Ichika[/url], [url=/c123760]Saki[/url], and [url=/c128183]Shiho[/url], but she became estranged from them after an incident that occured in middle school. 

She's the drummer of Leo/need.
